entities.name: Ferencz Ambruș
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ferencz Ambruș was a Romanian light-welterweight boxer. He competed at the 1952 Summer Olympics, but was eliminated in the second bout. He won two Romanian National Amateur Boxing Championship at the light-welterweight division in 1948 and 1949.
